title: Recording: I’m The Greatest, Oh My My by Ringo Starr | 1973
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

The seventh recording session for Ringo Starr’s third studio album, Ringo, took place on 14 March 1973.

This was an overdub session for two songs: ‘I’m The Greatest’ and ‘Oh My My’.

The backing track for ‘I’m The Greatest’ had been recorded with John Lennon, George Harrison, and Klaus Voormann the previous day, the first time three of the former Beatles had been in the studio together since 1970.

‘Oh My My’ had been started on 6 March, with overdubs added the following day. It was completed on 12 May 1973.
